item.title: Post and simple messages
item.description: Practise English for sending a letter, writing an address and giving a card. Use these words to write and read short messages.

children.definition: A message you write on paper and send to someone.
children.example: I got a letter from my cousin today.

children.definition: A small piece of paper you put on an envelope to show you paid to send it.
children.example: I need a stamp for this envelope.
collocations: put a stamp on an envelope

children.definition: A piece of thick paper you give or send to someone with a short message, for example to say happy birthday or thank you.
children.example: We gave our teacher a thank-you card.

children.definition: To put words, letters or numbers on paper or on a screen.
children.example: Can you write your name here?

children.definition: To make something go to another person or place.
children.example: I want to send this card to my aunt.

children.definition: A word or words that tell you who a person is.
children.example: Her name is on the front of the envelope.

children.definition: The thin, flat material you can write or draw on.
children.example: Do you have a piece of paper for my letter?

children.definition: A label such as 18 that tells you which house or room you mean.
A container with flat sides, often made of thick paper or wood.
children.example: I keep my birthday cards in a small box.

children.definition: A flat paper cover you put a letter or card inside.
children.example: This card is too big for the envelope.
collocations: put a letter in an envelope

children.definition: The details that tell you where someone lives or works, such as the street and house number.
A box where letters, cards and other post are delivered.
children.example: There is a letter for you in the mailbox.
collocations: put a letter in a mailbox

children.definition: To move, lift or break a closed part so you can see or get what is inside.
children.example: Open the envelope and read the letter.

children.definition: The words you say or write to give someone information, ask them something or tell them how you feel.
children.example: I wrote a short message inside Dad’s card.
